controls.reason: Adequately controlling six sources of result variability requires test-specific judgment and cannot be proved by configuration presence alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A test can pin the clock and random seed yet still misinterpret a concurrent or model-variable result because an uncontrolled scheduler or oracle assumption remains.

controls.reason: A versioned probabilistic-test contract can define the four exact numeric fields: confidence, sample size, uncertainty and acceptable error.
controls.counterexample_analysis: If any probabilistic test lacks one of the four typed values or uses an unapproved version, the finite schema and registry join fail.

controls.reason: Detecting false positives and negatives requires independent ground truth, while frequent and defect status need explicit thresholds and causal judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A validation set can show zero errors while missing the production class that causes false negatives, and override frequency can be mislabeled acceptable.

controls.reason: Golden outputs can be content-versioned, and every intentional change can require an identity-bound review instead of broad automatic acceptance.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An updated snapshot without an item-level approval or with a blanket auto-update event fails the exact provenance and review-policy checks.

controls.reason: Snapshot freshness metadata cannot prove that updated snapshots did not normalize unintended behavior; intent and correctness require an independent oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A developer can refresh every snapshot after a regression, producing current approved files that faithfully encode the new but wrong behavior.

controls.reason: Which oracles are material and whether their limitations and blind spots are complete require contextual judgment and knowledge of unknown failure modes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every registered material oracle can have a limitations section while an important shared-model blind spot is omitted or the oracle is wrongly marked immaterial.

controls.reason: Meaningful equivalence classes and representative valid and invalid members require domain judgment and a complete input-state model.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each field can have labeled classes and two examples while a semantically distinct authorization state is merged into the wrong class and never tested.

controls.reason: The ten named boundary labels do not define the complete input inventory, applicable bounds or authoritative expected behavior for each boundary.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One numeric field can have all ten cases while another bounded parameter and its overflow behavior remain untested.

controls.reason: Determining which behavior is combination-driven and whether a decision table contains all relevant rules and conditions requires semantic completeness judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A table can cover known plan and permission conditions while an undocumented tenant status changes the outcome and is absent.

controls.reason: A state model can exist for named examples without proving every stateful behavior, transition and recovery state is represented correctly.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All registered workflows can have diagrams while an implicit payment retry state remains outside the model.

controls.reason: Every valid and prohibited transition requires a complete state model, while which repeated, recovery and out-of-order transitions matter is contextual.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The transition suite can cover all modeled edges while a missing suspended-to-approved edge permits an untested authorization bypass.

controls.reason: Executing eight operation-disturbance categories does not establish complete operation, ordering, timing or correctness-oracle coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Tests can include one case per category while a duplicate after a partial commit produces an untested double effect.

controls.reason: Where eleven operations are supported depends on a complete capability inventory, and occurrence tests do not prove all objects and states.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known resources can have CRUD and transfer cases while a hidden restore endpoint or one archived object type remains untested.

controls.reason: Systematic coverage across roles, permissions, tenants, ownership, states and classifications requires a complete interaction model and risk-based adequacy judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A pairwise matrix can look systematic while a three-way tenant-owner-state combination permits unauthorized access.

controls.reason: Seven mode-labeled tests do not prove complete mode, transition, platform or behavior coverage or correct expected outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A maintenance-mode smoke test can pass while writes during transition into maintenance corrupt data on one platform.

controls.reason: Mapping branches to seven semantic categories and deciding which code is critical require judgment, while branch coverage alone is not a correctness oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All tagged critical branches can execute while an untagged authorization branch remains uncovered or assertions accept its wrong result.

controls.reason: Criticality, acceptable justification and adequacy of another verification method require reviewer judgment beyond an unexecuted-line workflow record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every uncovered line can have a rationale while a reachable critical recovery branch is incorrectly called defensive and left unverified.

controls.reason: Every coverage exclusion can be checked for an allowed exclusion class, explicit rationale and identity-bound review before metric removal.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An excluded platform-specific file without a rationale or approval remains in the denominator and cannot pass the exclusion ledger.

controls.reason: Changed-code coverage is computable, but identifying all impacted behavior requires complete semantic change-impact discovery beyond the measured registry.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A release can report both metrics while an undocumented consumer behavior is absent from the impact set and therefore from its coverage.

controls.reason: Evidence that six analyses ran does not prove their combined impact set is complete or that ownership and runtime evidence were interpreted correctly.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All six reports can exist while dynamic reflection hides a downstream call and the affected behavior is missed.

controls.reason: Retesting every affected consumer, producer, migration, tool, document and recovery procedure requires a complete and correct change-impact inventory.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All registered affected items can be retested while an undocumented operational script still depends on the changed schema.

controls.reason: Materiality and practicality are contextual, and no bounded source proves every qualifying defect and incident received a stable regression test.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A severe defect can be marked impractical without sound reason while all other retained tests satisfy the ledger.

controls.reason: Coverage decline and test deletion can be computed, but widening untested risk requires contextual risk and impact interpretation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Metrics can stay flat while a new critical untested path increases risk, yet the detector reports no widening.

controls.reason: A test run can be cryptographically bound to the intended production artifact digest, loaded modules, configuration and executed code provenance.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A test-only implementation or obsolete artifact has a different digest or execution trace and cannot satisfy the exact provenance binding.

controls.reason: Correctly labeling values as valid or invalid and modeling complete constraints requires a domain oracle, not merely a model created before generation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The model can predate generation yet wrongly permit an invalid plan-role combination, so generated coverage is based on a false oracle.

controls.reason: Given a sealed interaction model, constraints and execution manifest, achieved combination coverage after skips and failures is an exact set calculation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Counting an unavailable environment or failed case as covered produces a set mismatch and cannot pass the deterministic coverage computation.

controls.reason: Clear and safe rejection of invalid combinations is semantic and security-sensitive, and the invalid-combination space is not exhaustively defined.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known invalid fixtures can reject cleanly while an unmodeled incompatible setting fails open or leaks internal data.

controls.reason: Four category labels do not define complete version, rollout, migration and client-server combination inventories or expected compatibility outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The suite can contain one case per category while an old-client/new-server rollback combination remains missing.

controls.reason: Feature-flag interaction tests require the complete flag set and combinations; one default-state outage test does not prove all dependent behavior.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known pairwise flags can pass while a three-flag interaction under flag-service failure selects an unsafe default.

controls.reason: Including seven user-context dimensions does not specify meaningful combinations, supported values, platforms or accessibility and behavior oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A small pairwise sample can include every label while a screen-reader, locale and consent combination remains broken.

controls.reason: A signed campaign evidence manifest can require the six exact artifacts: models, constraints, seeds, coverage, and failing combinations with provenance.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Deleting a seed or failing-combination record breaks manifest completeness or its content digest.

controls.reason: Detecting every relevant configuration, topology, feature, dependency and platform change and updating model semantics correctly is unbounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All configured change events can update the model while an indirect dependency or newly supported platform is never discovered.

controls.reason: Which domain properties and invariants should hold across broad spaces is a semantic design and risk judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A team can document several true but trivial properties while omitting the essential conservation or authorization invariant.

controls.reason: Valid, adversarial and structurally diverse inputs require domain judgment, and generation occurrence does not prove adequate exploration or correct labels.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A generator can emit all five named classes while its adversarial cases are superficial and never reach the dangerous parser structure.

controls.reason: Respecting all domain constraints needs a complete constraint oracle, while unusual-combination exploration has no coverage definition or threshold.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Generated inputs can satisfy the modeled constraints while an omitted real constraint is violated and rare structures are never sampled.

controls.reason: Minimization execution is observable, but whether a counterexample is understandable is a human comprehension judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A shrinker can reduce an input by one byte and mark it minimal while the remaining thousand-step case is still unintelligible.

controls.reason: A minimized failing seed can be content-addressed, preserved and rerun with a pinned expected failure as a deterministic regression test.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing seed, non-reproducible environment or regression that no longer checks the failure violates the artifact and replay contract.

controls.reason: A stateful model schema can require the five finite elements: commands, preconditions, postconditions, transitions and observable state.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A model without observable-state definitions or transition identities fails the exact schema.

controls.reason: Applicability and correctness of algebraic laws require domain semantics, and finite property runs do not prove the laws over broad input spaces.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A commutativity test can pass sampled inputs even though the operation is noncommutative at a rare boundary, or the law is inapplicable.

controls.reason: Seven round-trip labels do not supply complete format, version, canonicalization and acceptable-loss oracles across all transformations.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known examples can round-trip while a valid alternate encoding loses metadata or canonicalizes inconsistently.

controls.reason: Authorization, tenant and privacy invariants are security claims over generated operations and unbounded state spaces; passing samples are not proof.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All generated sequences can pass while a missing cross-tenant transition lets one tenant read another's data.

controls.reason: Rare but important structures and acceptable generator bias require risk judgment plus explicit distribution and coverage thresholds.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A generator can reduce common values yet still almost never create the nested structure responsible for a critical defect.

controls.reason: Safe size and cost bounds, the meaning of deeper, and the periodic campaign cadence are all left unspecified.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A tiny daily run and slightly larger annual run can satisfy labels while never reaching the state space needed to expose the defect.

controls.reason: Coverage data can list unvisited states, but deciding which generator is weak and whether the state model itself is complete requires judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A generator reaches every modeled state while an important state is absent from the model, so feedback falsely suggests adequacy.

controls.reason: Every property-test failure classified as nondeterministic or flaky can require an open investigation record, owner and terminal disposition in the test ledger.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A flaky failure with no investigation identity or an unresolved item silently ignored cannot pass the exact failure-to-investigation join.

controls.reason: Defining a transformation is observable, but knowing the output relationship is valid requires an independent semantic oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A metamorphic relation can be documented and executable yet wrongly assert invariance under a transformation that changes the business meaning.

controls.reason: True implementation independence and adequate version, provider, algorithm and path selection require provenance and domain judgment beyond a test record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Two implementations can be separate packages copied from the same flawed logic and agree on the same wrong output.

controls.reason: Cross-version test occurrence cannot prove detection of every unintended compatibility or migration change without complete behaviors and independent oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Compared fixtures can match while an untested stored-data version is silently reinterpreted after upgrade.

controls.reason: Cross-environment comparisons cannot prove all drift or platform-dependent behavior is detected without a complete environment and behavior inventory.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Linux and macOS fixtures can agree while one production architecture or locale behaves differently and is absent.

controls.reason: Consistency testing across seven data views requires complete system inventory, defined relationships and correctness oracles for all update states.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known reports can reconcile while a delayed analytics partition silently drops records outside sampled windows.

controls.reason: Five identity examples do not define every applicable reconciliation invariant or prove correctness across full datasets and transitions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sample totals and checksums can match while an untested transfer violates conservation between accounts.

controls.reason: Choosing a valid statistical comparison, confidence model and assumptions for noisy outputs requires statistical expertise and distribution-specific judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A confidence interval can be calculated correctly under an invalid independence assumption and produce a misleading pass.

controls.reason: A signed differential-test evidence manifest can require relation definitions, transformations, seeds, normalization rules and discrepancy records.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Omitting a normalization rule or observed discrepancy breaks the finite manifest or its content hashes.

controls.reason: Selective scope and meaningful defect choice require risk judgment, and mutation scores do not by themselves prove tests detect real defects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A suite can kill selected trivial mutants while high-risk semantic mutants are excluded and assertions remain weak.

controls.reason: Every excluded mutant can be required to have an allowed category, documented rule application and identity-bound review decision.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An equivalent-mutant label without review or an irrelevant exclusion outside the approved rules fails the exact exclusion ledger.

controls.reason: Impracticality, risk focus and completeness of changed-code impact are contextual even though the resulting mutation percentage is computable.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A narrow risk set can report high coverage while critical impacted code is omitted after being judged low risk.

controls.reason: Avoiding hidden high-risk survivors requires correct risk classification and complete survivor inventory, not merely use of four cost controls.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sampling and parallel runs can look compliant while an excluded expensive operator hides the only critical surviving mutant.

controls.reason: Proving timeouts and flakes never cause false mutant classifications requires reliable causal attribution across nondeterministic executions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Retries can reproduce the recorded outcome while a timing-dependent test still falsely kills a mutant on one platform.

controls.reason: Survivor-pattern tracking is bounded, but whether resulting changes improve test standards and architecture requires causal effectiveness judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A recurring pattern can produce a standards edit while the same weak assertions remain and future survivors do not decrease.

controls.reason: A mutation-run manifest can require the five exact evidence classes: operators, exclusions, equivalence decisions, results and follow-up actions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A run missing a survivor action or excluded-mutant decision cannot pass the finite manifest and lineage checks.

controls.reason: Major, critical and relevant are contextual, and complete detection of refactoring impact is not established by a rerun record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A mutation job can rerun a narrow module while a major shared test-infrastructure refactor invalidates critical tests elsewhere.

controls.reason: Suitability for fuzzing is a security judgment, and identifying all components across ten interface classes requires a complete implementation inventory.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All known parsers can be assessed while a transitive deserializer or plugin state machine remains undiscovered.

controls.reason: Reaching real logic can be traced, but minimal unrelated setup is subjective and one exercised path does not prove the harness reaches meaningful vulnerable states.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A harness can call the production parser entry point yet stub the allocator or authentication state that contains the defect.

controls.reason: Valid seeds, supported-format representation and real structural diversity require domain and corpus-coverage judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A corpus can contain each labeled seed class while all files share the same simple structure and miss a supported complex feature.

controls.reason: Whether random bytes cannot reach meaningful states and whether a grammar is adequate require fuzzing and domain expertise.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A grammar-aware generator can be configured but omit a recursive production needed to reach the vulnerable state.

controls.reason: Coverage feedback can show unexplored code, but equivalent state feedback and completeness of the code or state inventory are not guaranteed.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The fuzzer reaches every instrumented block while a dynamically loaded parser module and semantic state remain invisible.

controls.reason: Instrumentation labels for seven failure classes do not prove complete language, process, build-mode and platform coverage or correct detection thresholds.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sanitizers can run on one binary while a native plugin lacks leak instrumentation and resource exhaustion has no valid limit.

controls.reason: Limits can be configured, but proving they cannot damage shared systems or conceal denial-of-service defects requires operational and security judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A strict memory cap protects the host yet kills cases before the product's own resource-exhaustion defect becomes visible.

controls.reason: High-risk classification and adequate continuous or recurring cadence require contextual thresholds; scheduled execution alone is insufficient.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A high-risk parser can run a one-minute monthly campaign and satisfy recurrence while providing negligible exploration.

controls.reason: Failure records can be deterministically clustered, minimized, and linked to immutable original input and exact environment provenance.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Discarding the original crash or merging failures with distinct stable signatures violates the finite lineage and deduplication contract.

controls.reason: Unique-failure identity, true root cause and all affected product versions require causal judgment and complete version-impact analysis.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every triage row can name a cause and versions while two defects are wrongly merged or an older affected release is omitted.

controls.reason: Every fuzz failure marked fixed can be required as a content-addressed case in the versioned regression corpus.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A fixed issue without its input and expected nonfailure result leaves a deterministic missing ledger-to-corpus link.

controls.reason: Where five stateful dimensions are relevant and which sequences cover them require protocol, state and risk judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One authentication and retry sequence can pass while an out-of-order concurrent transition remains unmodeled.

controls.reason: Safe rejection without partial side effects is a semantic security property over an unbounded rejected-input space.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known accepted and rejected seeds can pass while another malformed input writes partial state before failing.

controls.reason: Isolation from credentials, personal data, customers and uncontrolled egress is a universal negative claim over all harness and infrastructure paths.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sandbox policy can pass while a inherited cloud credential or DNS-based outbound channel remains available.

controls.reason: Campaign metrics are objective, but deciding whether the report treats any one metric as proof of completeness requires interpreting the report's meaning.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All six measurements can be present and correct while accompanying prose claims that coverage alone proves completeness, so the numeric manifest passes a violation.

controls.reason: Eight concurrent operation classes and stated guarantees do not define exhaustive schedules, states, platforms or correctness oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Representative tests can pass while a cancellation interleaving after failover violates ordering or loses an update.

controls.reason: Use of six scheduling controls does not establish coverage of all material race windows or correct outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A deterministic barrier test can exercise one race while a shorter lock-release window remains unreachable and defective.

controls.reason: Nine concurrency-failure labels do not provide exhaustive interleavings, resource states or behavioral oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each phenomenon can have a fixture while an untested three-party write skew still corrupts state.

controls.reason: Seven distributed guarantees at the actual boundary are universal behavioral claims requiring exhaustive histories and formal oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sample history analysis can pass while a rare retry violates exactly-once behavior after a partition.

controls.reason: Eight message disturbance tests do not prove coverage of all consumers, states, combinations or expected side effects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A poison-message fixture can pass while redelivery after consumer restart duplicates a non-idempotent payment.

controls.reason: Five time anomalies do not define all affected timers, platforms, transition combinations or correct outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Clock-skew tests can pass while leap behavior with delayed scheduling expires a valid session incorrectly.

controls.reason: Six distributed failure categories do not provide exhaustive topology, timing and reconciliation oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A planned partition test can pass while simultaneous leader change and replica lag produces split-brain writes.

controls.reason: Testing some in-progress cancellation and shutdown cases does not establish complete operation, phase or platform coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The suite can cancel a read while shutdown during a partially committed write loses data.

controls.reason: Guaranteeing retries never repeat non-idempotent effects or create storms is universal over errors, timing, consumers and retry paths.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known retry fixtures can pass while an unobserved timeout after commit repeats a charge and triggers cascading retries.

controls.reason: High-risk and feasibility are contextual, and using one formal or simulation technique does not prove concurrency coverage or model fidelity.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A feasible linearizability check can be waived as too costly, while a shallow simulation misses the critical violation.

controls.reason: Enough trace data and ability to reconstruct every failing interleaving require empirical replay and completeness over distributed event sources.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A trace contains all named field types yet omits a clock-domain relation needed to reproduce the failure.

controls.reason: A regression evidence record can require immutable schedules, seeds, histories and reduced scenarios with exact provenance.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Removing a history or retaining a nonreplayable schedule breaks the four-artifact manifest and reproducibility check.

controls.reason: Three interleaving categories do not define complete regions, versions, rollout phases, schedules or result oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A mixed-version test can pass in one region while a rolling deployment across two regions creates an untested conflict.

controls.reason: Authorization and tenant context across every asynchronous handoff is a security property requiring complete boundary and execution-path inventory.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Registered queues can preserve context while an internal callback drops tenant identity and runs under a broad service role.

controls.reason: Business invariants and conflict preservation require domain judgment and universal recovery and reconciliation path coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sample recoveries can balance totals while one conflict is silently discarded in a rare failback sequence.

controls.reason: Scenario derivation from six sources can be recorded, but sufficiency and correct interpretation of architecture, threats and incidents require judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One trivial scenario per source can satisfy provenance fields while the most likely dependency cascade is omitted.

controls.reason: Eight dependency failure labels do not establish complete dependency, combination, timing or expected fallback coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All cases can run against one mock while a real provider's partial stale response corrupts state.

controls.reason: Applicability and complete combinations of ten infrastructure failures depend on topology and platform inventories not supplied by the rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Single-fault tests can pass while simultaneous disk-full and node-loss recovery fails on an untested zone.

controls.reason: Six control-plane and cryptographic failures do not define all affected services, timing combinations or correctness and security oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A certificate-expiry drill can pass while secret rotation during DNS failure leaves one service using revoked credentials.

controls.reason: Verifying eight resilience controls requires workload-specific thresholds and behavioral oracles across every failure and interaction path.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each control can have a passing fixture while a fallback returns stale unauthorized data under combined timeout and overload.

controls.reason: Preserving correctness, security, privacy and tenant isolation during resilience behavior is a universal semantic claim, not proof from test occurrence.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Availability tests can pass while load shedding exposes cross-tenant cached data on an untested path.

controls.reason: Six recovery exercise records do not prove complete data, topology, configuration or failure coverage and correct restoration.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A backup restore can pass for sampled data while a missing encrypted archive or configuration dependency prevents a real clean recovery.

controls.reason: For a bounded recovery experiment, the five named outcomes can be measured from authoritative timestamps, state diffs and effect ledgers.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A run missing actual RPO, RTO, data-loss, duplicate-effect or degradation values fails the exact measurement schema; no adequacy threshold is inferred.

controls.reason: More realistic is contextual, while blast radius, stop and rollback controls must be judged adequate for each experiment and environment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A sequence can move from mock to staging with all three control fields while staging lacks a production-only dependency and rollback cannot undo side effects.
